prompt: The client asks: "Should we start selling online?" Fact sheet: online sales in the category grow 25% a year; 40% of our customers say they would buy online; setting up online sales costs $1M; expected first-year online sales are $4M at a 20% margin; we have 30 stores; our stores were renovated in 2021. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: Online is growing 25% a year in the category, 40% of customers say they would buy online, and $4M of first-year sales at a 20% margin recovers most of the $1M setup cost in year one. The main risk is that online sales cannibalize the 30 stores. Putting it together, launch online sales.
